blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara completed a three-game Pool G sweep in the Asian Games 2026 women’s beach volleyball tournament on Saturday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. The young Alas Pilipinas pair faced their toughest battle yet but kept their composure to edge Hong Kong’s Wing Man To and Wing Tung To, 21-19, 21-17, and remain unbeaten after the pool stage. Progella and Pagara will enter the round of 16 as the top seed from Pool G. Sisi Rondina and Bernadeth Pons finished second in Pool […]...
